node.title: E22 common-tail invariance certificate soundness
node.statement: If an E22 cofactor-tail certificate specifies a common tail B, dyadic local moduli M_i>t, verifies |B|<min_i M_i, and verifies that each T_i\B is invariant under the M_i-th-root kernel, then e22_cofactor_common_tail_kernel_invariance holds.
node.attack_surface: finite certificate semantics for common-tail, tail-bound, local-modulus, and kernel-invariance data
node.falsifier: a verified common-tail invariance certificate that does not imply the E22 common-tail kernel-invariance predicate
